detached_structure.evidence: A large dark-roofed building sits to the upper right of the central house, but it may belong to a neighboring lot or share the driveway. A smaller dark roofed section attaches to the lower-left of the main house.

signals.notes: The central house sits under heavy mature tree canopy with a small grassy clearing behind it, and three cars are parked on the driveway/paved area to its right; falling leaf and shade cover limit the roof view.
